findings.claim: FY2026 訂單 $22.2B（+27%），Q4 訂單 $6.1B（+29%）；管理層預期 FY2027 銷售雙位數成長，Q1 約+中段兩位數
findings.source: TE Connectivity Q4 FY2026 press release (2026-10-28)
findings.excerpt: Orders of $22.2 billion, up 27%, supporting expected double-digit sales growth in fiscal 2027.
